summary: Sanders County, MT lookout on the Flathead Reservation: 1934 pole tower, 1938 L-4 tower, current cab built 1983, staffed each summer per CSKT; no public visiting route found, so ask the tribes first.

facts.design: Two-story wood cab with shed roof on a concrete base (1983); earlier L-4 cab (1964)
facts.agency: Lolo National Forest/Flathead Indian Reservation (firelookout.com listing)

access.note: The tribes list the lookout among those on the Flathead Reservation, and a 1938 report puts the peak on the boundary with the Cabinet Forest. The sources read give no public visiting route and state no permission rule.

events.note: 50-foot pole tower with L-4 cab, following the 1934 platform tower
Current wood cab on a concrete base; CSKT calls it a new lookout built in 1983

corrections.proposed: No total height is sourced for the current cab. 3.7 m matches the 12-foot base that CSKT gives.
corrections.why: The 12-foot base is about 3.7 m. The 1940 survey gives about 30 feet for the earlier wooden tower, not 3.7 m.

corrections.proposed: L-4 cab (1964) on the earlier tower; the 1983 cab is a two-story wood cab with a shed roof
corrections.why: L-4 describes the 1938 tower and the 1964 cab. The 1983 cab is described as two-story with a shed roof.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1940 survey description gives the wooden tower as about 30 feet high, but the 1938 tower is given as 50 feet. The story reports both figures and says the sources do not explain the difference.

Firelookout.com and the Forest Lookouts page date the first tower to 1934. CSKT says the peak was first posted in the late 1950s or early 1960s. Both are reported in the story; the 1934 date is kept because it comes with a tower description.
Firelookout.com says a 10-foot concrete base and CSKT says a 12-foot cinderblock base. The story reports both and does not pick one.

sources.title: Fire Lookouts on the Flathead Reservation
sources.publisher: Confederated Salish and Kootenai Tribes, Division of Fish, Wildlife, Recreation & Conservation

notes_for_editor: The brief's 1983 built event is right for the current cab per CSKT, but the 1934 and 1938 towers were missing; they are added. The height_m of 3.7 m equals the 12-foot base, not total height. The access level was changed from permission to unknown on 2026-10-09: no source states a permission rule, and the ask-the-tribes wording is advice. No fire, rental or closure information was found. The fate of the 1934 and 1938 towers is not recorded. The 'late 1950s or early 1960s' first posting has no exact year, so it is not in events. Read budget ran slightly over (7 cached fetches, 1 WebSearch).
